items.title: A separable algebraic residue field extension is realised by a colimit of finite etale extensions
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file algebra.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: For a local ring with residue field k and a separable algebraic extension K of k, the lemma produces a directed system of finite etale extensions of local rings whose colimit has residue field K (statement lines 44859-44866). The proof does not build the system directly: it takes the well-ordered extension constructed earlier, treats successor steps by tensoring a finite etale extension with the colimit presentation already obtained, and treats limit steps by observing that every finite subset lies in an earlier stage (proof lines 44868-44889). Splitting the transfinite induction into those two cases is the content, and the author writes both out. H2.
